title: Remove redundant parse-peer AcDs payload copy during raw modeler validation
scope: Remove the temporary parse-peer copy of DataStorage payload bytes absent from the raw entity frame
Preserve the pending owned payload copy required across the callback-to-finalize lifetime
Preserve exact section-span validation, ownership checks, and writer replay behavior

implementation.behavior: The raw-frame parse-peer comparison no longer copies DRW_ModelerGeometry::dataStorageData into a temporary peer object. Those AcDs bytes are absent from the raw entity frame; the former comparison compared the source with an identical copy. Exact payload equality remains enforced at finalization against validated inline/Blob01 section spans using the pending writer-owned payload copy.
implementation.copyRemoved: One temporary parsedPeer.dataStorageData vector copy per storage-backed modeler frame validation.
implementation.copyRetained: PendingModelerDataStorageReplay continues to own a payload copy because callback-based writers may receive short-lived modeler objects and finalization occurs after callback return.
preservedControls: ACIS marker detection across Blob01 page boundaries
limitations: raw AcDs section storage remains owned by the writer/source data model
this does not bound allocator capacity or whole-process RSS
the slice is not independent reader or semantic solid evidence

workingTree.reasonNotCommitted: The shared worktree is broadly dirty with user-owned changes; the slice was kept isolated and uncommitted.
